notes: While it means 'goodbye', it is often used as a casual 'see you later' even if you plan to meet again soon.

In some Spanish-speaking regions, it can sound quite final. If you are leaving friends you will see tomorrow, 'hasta luego' or 'nos vemos' are often preferred to avoid sounding like you are saying goodbye for a long time.

senses.definition: A word said to someone when you are leaving or when they are leaving.
